newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM SEES LOWER YEAR NET BEFORE PROVISION.
newsitem.headline: KLM SEES LOWER YEAR NET BEFORE PROVISION.

text.p: Dutch national carrier KLM Royal Dutch Airlines said on Tuesday it expected its full-year net income after tax to fall by 150 million guilders from year-earlier levels before a restructuring provision.

"Taking into account the expected increase in fuel costs for the full year of 231 million guilders (150 million after tax), we expect net income after tax for 1996-97 to decrease approximately 150 million guilders compared to last year before any provision for costs of restructuring," it said in a statement.
